harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built a healthy three-member etcd 3.7.1 cluster on node1–node3 with mutual TLS on client and peer listeners. node4 provides authenticated administration and scheduled backups. The required value is replicated, one-member outage/recovery was proven, a current restorable snapshot remains at /var/backups/etcd/recovery.db, and all four nodes passed rolling reboot persistence checks.
actions_performed: Installed checksum-verified etcd tooling on all nodes.
Created a private CA and node-specific certificates with locally generated private keys.
Configured persistent, boot-enabled etcd services and firewall access on node1–node3.
Configured authenticated administration and an enabled backup timer on node4.
Proved reads and writes continue with node3 unavailable and that node3 resynchronizes after returning.
Created, validated, restored, and boot-tested the recovery snapshot.
Restarted node1, node2, node3, and node4 sequentially, verifying changed boot identities and recovery after each.

evidence.requirement: Healthy three-member cluster on node1, node2, and node3
evidence.summary: Final authenticated membership shows exactly three started voting members; all endpoints are healthy and share Raft term 5 and applied index 53 without errors.

evidence.requirement: Mutual TLS protects client and peer traffic
evidence.summary: Before and after the rolling restarts, all six client/peer listeners rejected TLS connections lacking a client certificate with `certificate required`, while authenticated administration succeeded.
Direct linearizable reads from every member returned `ready`, including in the final state.

evidence.requirement: Continue consistent reads and writes with one member unavailable, then resynchronize it
evidence.summary: After a healthy baseline, node3 was stopped alone. node1/node2 committed and linearly read a new proof value; node3 returned with that value and all members reconverged.

evidence.requirement: node4 administration and current recovery snapshot
evidence.summary: node4 has an enabled/active backup timer and a mode-0600 current snapshot. The exact refreshed snapshot was restored into an isolated mTLS instance, which returned both expected values.
Shows healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered local service/data/membership, and full-cluster convergence.
Shows healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered local service/data/membership, and full-cluster convergence.

Shows healthy administration/backup baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered timer, snapshot, credentials, cluster access, data, and membership.
